full_page.content:
Page 53
Aug. 10 Eugene McNulty - 48 (of Huntington) Hopeless with "Spacia" - slow paralysis - Doctoring for about 9 yrs. - Mayo's, etc. - goes to holy Communion weekly. Was pleased at being urged to promote frequent Communion. - Enrolls perpetually - self and PP. Souls 10.00
Oct. 18th Randall Gerow - 2 - brought To-day from 14628 Rabeon, Redford, Michigan; bright lively child, However, he has a peculiarly threatening-conditioned neck - uncanny groth over juggler & al- most frightening voice. The methodest Father drove down in the rain and waits out in car till called in. The mother a one time Catholic not to sacraments for years ...... They enroll child and both kneel for blessing of Cross relic ... quite hopefully smiling .docilly promising.
1948
1948, July
July 25th Feast of St. James 48 Anniv. - Minor Orders To-day about 50 or 60 here from N. Man. Ind.with Sunday School - Young Methodist Minister also who had accompanied them came in during talk in Chapel and seemed much interested - came into Of- fice afterwards with wife and several others. Deo Gr.
Page 54 Nov. 26 B. M. Chaplow
Page 55
1949, December
Dec. 17 Stephen Poinsatte - 6 yrs. old - 4507 Lafeyette Esp. - Fort Wayne Ind. - On way to Mayo Clynic, Rchester for very serious operation - removal of right lung .... Reports from specialist ... "God help us"!
1950
1950, January
Jan. 7th Karen Galloway - 5 Dec. 26 last - T. B. Maningitis .... "Hopeless" - came by plane from Cleveland, O. to Ft. Wayne. Enrolled. 1954
1954, July
July 21st Mrs. Blanch Ehinger - 2913 Euclid, Ft. Wayne, Ind. - 57 - cancer of mouth and neck - very threatening - enrolled To-day. Oct. 15th Same Mrs. Ehinger here To-day. Tells us, now in perfect health. The doctors had told her in July she could not live over a month .... Now astonished at her smiling condition. Glory be to God! She en- rolls the Holy Souls specially in Thanksgiving. Deo Grat! 5.00
